text:
Zoe: Quick thread on finalizing form validation defaults for Console: inline vs summary, required field signaling, and deletion confirmations. Short takes only.

Ben: Inline-first for field-level problems. Top-summary only when submit returns multiple errors or for long forms (>=8 fields).

Priya: Agree. Also recommend inline validation on blur for format checks, and on-submit for presence/required.

Sam: Accessibility note: asterisk alone isn’t sufficient. If we keep '*' visually add an sr-only "Required" and aria-required on the input. Avoid color-only indicators.

Olivia: UI compromise: hide visible "Required" helper on dense forms, show sr-only. For simple/short forms show visible helper.

Ben: Deletion: soft delete + undo snackbar for single items. Bulk deletes show scope/count in the snackbar and allow undo. Permanent ops need typed confirm (resource name).

Priya: Edge-case: slow connections might swallow snackbar. Ensure Trash/Activity log retains a recoverable copy for 30 days.

Sam: Quick a11y checklist to include in the doc:
- Inline errors: aria-invalid on fields, role=alert on error message, focus first error after submit.
- Top summary: role=alert, list of anchors that focus fields when activated.
- Required: aria-required + sr-only text.
- Typed confirm: label clearly states permanence.

Zoe: Decisions: default inline (real-time/blur); top-summary for forms >=8 fields or multi-step submits; '*' + sr-only Required; single-item soft delete with undo; typed confirm for irreversible/policy deletes.
